bounded_slice.candidate: Canonical content-binding control for the p1-sa-593 replay-record semantics, separating deterministic coverage of provenance/executable fields from the independently trusted reference needed to turn a digest into tamper evidence.
bounded_slice.tested_scope: Deterministic local projection and one-field mutation analysis anchored only to p1-sa-593. No public-source fetch, no actual hash/signature computation, no hosted verifier, no secret persistence, no protected/manual execution and no second semantic leaf.

canonical_projection_v1.purpose: Bind every provenance-critical or executable replay field identified by p1-sa-593 plus the derived outcome claim; intentionally exclude volatile transport metadata.
canonical_projection_v1.canonical_serialization: Project only the included field classes into one JSON object; recursively sort object keys by their exact stored key strings; preserve array order; preserve string code points exactly with no normalization; serialize booleans as true/false and integers as base-10 JSON integers; emit no insignificant whitespace. The projection_id is part of the projected object so a verifier cannot silently switch projection rules without changing the bound content.
canonical_projection_v1.minimality_note: Within this tested scope, removing any of the five provenance/policy field classes from p1-sa-593 would recreate a mutation that can preserve replay outputs while escaping content binding; removing replay inputs, observation values, the attempt limit or derived outcome would permit an executable input or evidence claim to change without changing the projection. Volatile timestamp/path/continuation are excluded because they are not part of the tested replay semantics.

trusted_reference_result.observation: All provenance/policy and executable one-field mutations tested above change the canonical projection; the volatile timestamp negative control does not. A digest of that projection would therefore be sensitive to every tested replay-critical mutation, including the p1-sa-593 cases that semantic replay alone could not authenticate.
trusted_reference_result.inference: A digest computed over mutable content is not by itself evidence of originality. To make content-addressed verification tamper-evident, the verifier needs an independently trusted expected reference for the projection. If the verifier protocol already fixes projection_id and digest algorithm, the minimum variable trusted datum is the expected digest. If those are not fixed externally, the minimum trusted tuple is {projection_id, digest_algorithm, expected_digest}. The expected reference must come from a trust channel independent of the mutable record being checked; a digest stored only inside that same record is self-referential and insufficient.
trusted_reference_result.repository_content_address_scope: A Git blob identity can serve as a content address for exact repository bytes only when the expected blob identity itself is obtained from an independently trusted reference. It does not by itself solve repository-compromise, authorization, signer/key distribution, rotation/revocation or freshness/rollback questions, and it is not equivalent to the canonical projection unless the verified bytes and projection procedure are fixed together.
trusted_reference_result.package_completeness: pass only for content-binding coverage of the exact projected replay field classes and mutation matrix above
trusted_reference_result.replayability: pass for the deterministic projection/mutation relation; no cryptographic digest implementation was executed in this slice
trusted_reference_result.hidden_executor_absence: pass for exact slice: only local deterministic reasoning and repository API state/evidence transport were used; no hosted verifier, richer mode, Work, protected-primary action, manual-user execution, secret persistence or second semantic leaf
trusted_reference_result.quota_zero_assessment: The projection and mutation classification is local deterministic reasoning and remains valid with optional hosted compute/storage/model quotas at zero. Repository transport is lightweight state/evidence transport and any rate limit is handled by cross-invocation continuation rather than same-run waiting.
trusted_reference_result.conflict_check: CLEAN-safe: only frozen sanitized controls and own scientist_agents LATEST/predecessor checkpoint were semantically consumed. No O/downstream/other-worker/shared-ledger/protected/manual/scheduler semantics were consumed.
trusted_reference_result.uncertainty: Not tested: actual hash/signature computation, cryptographic collision/preimage assumptions, canonicalizer interoperability across implementations, malformed/duplicate JSON keys, Unicode edge cases, signed Git commit verification, repository compromise, independently trusted reference distribution, authorization, key distribution, rotation/revocation, freshness/rollback, duplicate identifiers, threshold policy or heterogeneous verification cost.
